content: A lesson without pain is meaningless. That's because you cannot gain something without sacrificing something else in return.
Humankind cannot gain anything without first giving something in return. To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.
Anywhere can be paradise as long as you have the will to live.
Whatever happens, happens.
Overspecialize, and you breed in weakness. It's slow death.
Hard work is worthless for those that don't believe in themselves.
When people are protecting something truly special to them, they truly can become as strong as they can be.
If you don't take risks, you can't create a future.
When do you think people die? When they are forgotten.
We fear that which we cannot see.
This world is rotten, and those who are making it rot deserve to die.
The only ones who should kill are those who are prepared to be killed.
If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win.
The only thing we're allowed to do is to believe that we won't regret the choice we made.
Don't believe in yourself. Believe in me who believes in you.
You should enjoy the little detours to the fullest, because that's where you'll find the things more important than what you want.
No matter how much I struggle, there's always a price to pay for changing the past.
Don't be afraid of things you don't understand. Just accept them as they are.
Once you've met someone, you never really forget them.
Life is suffering. It is hard. The world is cursed. But still, you find reasons to keep on living.
A heart's a heavy burden.
Trees and people used to be good friends.
I feel like I'm always searching for someone, or something.

attribution: March Comes in Like a Lion
content: Even if you can't see it, the river keeps flowing under the ice.
You have no enemies. Nobody has any enemies. There is nobody that you should hurt.
If everyone is not special, maybe you can be what you want to be.
When you look at someone's kindness, it's like looking at the sun.
What I want more than anything is for you to live and help me live too.
People's lives don't end when they die. They end when they lose faith. A person who is remembered by someone still has something of themselves left in the world, and that is not nothing.
Whatever you lose, you'll find it again. But what you throw away you'll never get back. That is the difference between a mistake and a decision, and most people learn it far too late.
If you don't take risks, you can't create a future. Everyone wants the result without the part where it might not work, and that part is the whole of it. There is no other door in.

A lesson without pain is meaningless. That's because you can't gain something without sacrificing something else in return. But once you've overcome it and made it your own, you will gain a heart strong enough not to be overcome by anything.
The world is not beautiful, and that in a way lends it a sort of beauty. A thing that had no flaw would have nothing to notice about it, and nobody would ever look twice.
